summary: ProtoKinetix, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of director Edward McDonough effective March 31, 2026, and the appointment of three new directors on June 17, 2026: Michael Jones, Jason Lamp, and Keith Brunt, who also became president. The departures and appointments are described as voluntary and not involving disagreements. Brunt brings scientific and clinical expertise and previously served as a Medical Science Advisor. No transaction terms, prices, or advisors are mentioned. The changes may signal a strategic pivot; watch for future operational announcements.
